notes: 'Penalty' also names events in hockey, rugby and wrestling; titles matching other sports are excluded and the vision stage is the real test (it must find a goal with a net).
49 of 49 permit video redistribution with attribution; 30 of those are share-alike, so any republished copy must carry the same licence.
Spectator-filmed, so framing varies from behind-the-goal 4K to a wide stand view where the kicker is a few dozen pixels tall. QC grades what was recoverable.
redistribution_note: Redistribution is decided per file from its own licence. Share-alike files are kept for local analysis and not republished, because republishing them would impose CC BY-SA on the aggregate.
title: Wikimedia Commons -- freely licensed penalty-kick video

notes: 37 of those half-videos map to SoccerNet matches, so a SoccerNet NDA holder could cut those segments directly using the bounds published here.
